map.安全防护用品更换周期提醒 使用指南: PPE Replacement Cycle Reminder User Guide
map.个人防护用品（PPE）更换与检查跟踪，内置更换周期数据库，按到期紧急度排序，提醒: Tracks the replacement and inspection of PPE, with a built-in replacement cycle database sorted by urgency, reminding you to replace and inspect on time.
map.记录安全帽、防护眼镜、防尘口罩等 8 类 PPE 的领用日期与更换周期，自动算出: Records the issue date and replacement cycle for 8 categories of PPE such as hard hats, safety goggles and dust masks, computes the next due date automatically and reminds you sorted by urgency.
map.周期设为 0（如防毒面具滤盒、手套）表示按需检查，不自动计算到期日，仅纳入检查清: A cycle of 0 (such as a respirator filter cartridge or gloves) means inspect as needed: no due date is calculated automatically and it only joins the inspection checklist.
map.每次检查按清单逐项勾选，记录合格/不合格并留存检查历史，方便后续追溯与定期复核。: At each inspection tick the items off one by one, record pass or fail and keep the inspection history for later traceability and periodic review.
map.到期计算逻辑: How the due date is calculated
map.：下次到期日 = 领用日期 + 更换周期(天)；剩余天数 = 下次到期日 − 今: Next due date = issue date + replacement cycle (days); days remaining = next due date − today. The urgent threshold is min(max(3, round(cycle×0.1)), 30) days and the soon threshold is min(max(7, round(cycle×0.2)), 60) days; less than 0 is overdue, at or below urgent is urgent, at or below soon is due soon, otherwise normal.
map.：安全帽周期 913 天（约 30 个月），领用 2025-01-01，则下次到: A hard hat cycle of 913 days (about 30 months) issued on 2025-01-01 is next due 2027-07-02; safety goggles with a 365 day cycle issued on 2026-01-01 are next due 2027-01-01; a dust mask with a 30 day cycle issued on 2026-08-20 is due 2026-09-19, entering the urgent alert about 3 days ahead.
map.事故频率 / 严重率统计报表: Accident frequency / severity rate statistical report
map.为什么有些用品周期设为 0？: Why are some items set to a cycle of 0?
map.防毒面具滤盒、防护手套等按实际损坏或暴露环境更换，无法用固定天数推算到期，故设为: Respirator filter cartridges and protective gloves are replaced on actual damage or exposure, which cannot be predicted from a fixed number of days, so the cycle is set to 0 to mean inspect as needed and the tool only tracks the inspection records without predicting a due date.
map.安全帽受过重击但还没到周期怎么办？: What if the hard hat was struck hard but is not yet due?
map.安全帽壳体出现裂纹或受过重击应立即更换，不论是否到期；可在检查清单标记不合格并记: A helmet shell that is cracked or has taken a heavy blow must be replaced immediately whether or not it is due; mark it as failed in the checklist with a record, then run "mark as replaced" to reset the issue date.
